manifest.name: @local/dsh-git-status
manifest.description: dsh plugin: Git project / worktree / branch and linked GitHub issue & PR numbers in the bottom status bar

readme.text:
A [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI plugin that shows the current
Session's Git project, worktree, branch, and linked GitHub issue / pull-request numbers in the **bottom status bar**.

```
⌾ athena │ 🌳 issue-1122-openai-embed │ ⎇ feat/issue-1122-openai-embed │ ◉ 1122 │ ⤴ 1153
```
The footer of the window gains one 24px status bar (`shell.bottom`, kept across main-panel navigation):

| Segment | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `git` icon + name | the **project** directory name — the main worktree's directory name |
| worktree icon + name | the **linked worktree** directory name; only shown while the Session's directory is a linked worktree |
| branch icon + name | the current branch (a short sha for a detached HEAD) |
| issue icon + number | GitHub issue parsed from the worktree directory name (`issue-1234-…`); shown only when linked |
| pull-request icon + number | the PR associated with the current worktree HEAD commit; shown only when linked |

The issue / pull-request numbers are links: a plain click opens the page in the **right-Sidebar in-app browser**
(`ctx.sidebarRight.openTab('browser', …)`), with a new-window fallback when that surface is unavailable; modified
clicks keep the native new-window behavior. Non-Git directories and missing directories render the reason instead.

- dsh with the Web UI (desktop app or `dsh web`) that provides the `shell.bottom` slot (0.2.x).
- `git` on `PATH`.
- Optional: the `gh` CLI logged in with `repo` scope, used to resolve the PR linked to the current HEAD commit.
  Set `GH_BIN` to point at a specific `gh` executable if it is not in `PATH`, Homebrew, or `~/.local/bin`.
This is a local dsh **bundle** (not an npm package), installed into a dsh profile:

1. Clone this repository anywhere on the machine that runs dsh.
2. Add the bundle to your dsh profile, either:
   - ask the dsh agent to install the bundle at the cloned path (`plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`), or
   - edit `<profile dir>/package.json` manually:
     ```json
     {
       "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…", "@local/dsh-git-status"] } },
       "dependencies": { "@local/dsh-git-status": "link:/path/to/dsh-git-status" }
     }
     then install the profile dependencies with pnpm and restart dsh.
3. The status bar appears at the very bottom of the window. A dsh restart is the safest way to load the bundle the
   first time.

- The Client half (`client.js`) renders the bar into the root-scoped `shell.bottom` slot and polls
  `GET /git-status/api?session=<id>` every 2.5s (paused while the page is hidden).
- The Host half (`index.js`) resolves the Session's working directory through `ctx.get('workingDirectory')`, then
  runs:

```text
  git rev-parse --show-toplevel
  git rev-parse --git-dir --git-common-dir
  git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
  git rev-parse --short HEAD

- A linked worktree is detected by `git-dir ≠ git-common-dir`; the main worktree is the first `worktree list` entry.
- The issue number is parsed from the worktree directory name (`^issue[-_]?123…`).
- The pull request is resolved asynchronously with
  `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/<sha>/pulls` (cache 120s, failures 60s) so the bar never waits for GitHub.
- The GitHub remote comes from `git config --get remote.origin.url`; a non-GitHub remote skips PR resolution.

```bash
node test/host-smoke.mjs /path/to/any/git/repo
```

The smoke test drives the Host half with a stub Cordis context and checks its JSON contract against a real
repository. It requires `git` only; the `gh` lookup degrades to `pull: null` when unavailable.

Files:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: HTTP route, Git reads, `gh` cache, working-directory resolution |
| `client.js` | Client half: the bottom status bar |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the `git-status` row |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Plugin-manager display metadata |
| `icon.svg` | Icon artwork |
| `test/host-smoke.mjs` | Host-half smoke test |

- `shell.bottom` is a **single** slot: this plugin and any other bottom-status plugin are mutually exclusive, and a
  future dsh release that ships its own bottom bar would be shadowed by this plugin.
- The issue number relies on the `issue-<number>` worktree directory naming convention; PR association needs `gh`
  authentication and network access.
- The bar is 24px tall and the columns shrink by that height.
- Rendering is verified through the slot registry and the HTTP contract; pixel-level checks need the live GUI.

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The issue and pull-request glyphs come from [Octicons](https://github.com/primer/octicons) (MIT).

一个 [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI 插件：在窗口**底部状态栏**显示当前
会话所在目录的 Git 项目、工作树、分支，以及关联的 GitHub issue / PR 编号。

```
⌾ athena │ 🌳 issue-1122-openai-embed │ ⎇ feat/issue-1122-openai-embed │ ◉ 1122 │ ⤴ 1153
```

底部 24px 状态栏（`shell.bottom`，跨主面板导航保留）：`git 图标 + 项目目录名`（主工作树目录名）、`工作树图标 + 工作树目录名`
（仅当前目录是 linked worktree 时出现）、`分支图标 + 分支名`（detached HEAD 显示短 sha）、`issue 图标 + 编号`
（工作树目录名 `issue-xxx` 时出现）、`PR 图标 + 编号`（当前 HEAD 关联 PR 时出现）。issue / PR 编号可点击：普通点击用
**右侧面板的内置浏览器**打开（`ctx.sidebarRight.openTab('browser', …)`，不可用时回退新窗口），带修饰键的点击保持原生新窗口；
非 Git 目录或目录不存在时显示原因。

这是一个 dsh 本地 **bundle**（不是 npm 包），装进 dsh profile：

1. 把仓库克隆到运行 dsh 的机器任意目录；
2. 用 dsh Agent 的 `plugin_manager` → `install_bundle` 指向该目录，或手动在 `<profile>/package.json` 里加上
   `dependencies`（`link:/path/to/dsh-git-status`）与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 条目，装好依赖后重启 dsh；
3. 首次加载最稳妥的方式是重启 dsh，窗口最底部就会出现状态栏。

依赖：`git`；可选 `gh`（已登录、`repo` scope）用于 PR 关联，`GH_BIN` 可指定 gh 路径。

Client 半把状态栏注册进 root 作用域的 `shell.bottom`，每 2.5s 轮询 `GET /git-status/api?session=<id>`（页面隐藏时暂停）；
Host 半用 `ctx.get('workingDirectory')` 解析会话目录，跑 `git rev-parse` / `git worktree list --porcelain` 取项目、工作树、分支，
issue 号按工作树目录名解析，PR 用 `gh api …/commits/<sha>/pulls` 异步查询（缓存 120s，失败降级不阻塞）。

- `shell.bottom` 是单占位槽：与其它底部状态栏插件互斥，未来 dsh 若自带底栏会被本插件遮蔽；
- issue 依赖 `issue-<数字>` 的工作树命名约定，PR 关联依赖 `gh` 登录态与网络；
- 状态栏高 24px，三列会相应收缩。

[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
